parts.text: 登录接口失败应该刷新图形验证码

The user wants the graphic captcha refreshed when the **login API fails**. Looking at the current `submit()` (login) function, its `catch` only shows an error toast and the `finally` only resets `loading` — it never refreshes the captcha (unlike `sendSmsCode`, whose `finally` already refreshes). Let me fix that.
